concept_options.title: The Label Doesn't Say Sustainable. It Says What's In It.
concept_options.hook: The label doesn't say 'sustainable.' It says exactly what's in it.
concept_options.visual_approach: Kinetic hero-product reveal of the Heavyweight Hoodie (black/red) on cream/navy brand backgrounds, HyperFrames-driven type animation carrying the argument since no live-model footage exists
concept_options.target_audience: Gen Z / young millennial streetwear buyers who are sustainability-aware but greenwashing-fatigued
key_points: Real product, not a model shoot — the piece is the star
One specific, verifiable material/production claim replaces vague sustainability language
Premium construction framed as durability, not just ethics
concept_options.core_message: Angels in Daylight proves its claims with specifics, not slogans.
concept_options.cta: Shop the collection — link in bio
grounded_in: Roughly 60% of sustainability claims in fashion are unsubstantiated or misleading...
concept_options.why_this_works: Directly neutralizes the #1 research risk: vague sustainability copy reads as greenwashing to 73% of this audience who've already abandoned a purchase over it. Specificity is the differentiator.

concept_options.title: No Model. Just the Piece.
concept_options.visual_approach: Straight kinetic product-reveal treatment leaning fully into the 'product as hero' framing rather than working around the missing model footage
concept_options.target_audience: Streetwear-first buyers who care more about the garment than lifestyle imagery
key_points: Owns the constraint (no live footage) as a stylistic choice instead of hiding it
Fast cuts matching the 3-second-hook research finding
Fabric macro insert for texture credibility
grounded_in: Kinetic Typography Explained Through 12 Real Brand Examples
concept_options.why_this_works: Lowest production risk (no dependency on any footage we don't have) and rides the kinetic-typography trend that performs on sound-off feeds — but it's a weaker sustainability argument than c1.

concept_options.title: Built Heavier. Lasts Longer.
concept_options.hook: Built heavier. Lasts longer. Costs the planet less by costing you fewer replacements.
concept_options.visual_approach: Durability-framed reveal — hoodie weight/construction close-ups, reframes sustainability as a value/longevity argument
concept_options.target_audience: Value-conscious buyers who are sustainability-adjacent but not activist-motivated
key_points: Sidesteps greenwashing skepticism entirely by not making an environmental claim at all
Durability is a provable, demonstrable claim from the product itself
concept_options.core_message: Fewer replacements is the most honest form of sustainability.
grounded_in: 75% of Gen Z say sustainability is more important than brand name...
concept_options.why_this_works: Most defensible claim (durability is directly demonstrable) but slower emotional hook than c1 — better suited to Instagram's slightly longer attention window than TikTok's 3-second cliff.

selected_concept.rationale: c1 directly answers the research brief's single biggest finding (greenwashing skepticism) while still using the available assets honestly (kinetic product reveal, no fabricated model footage). Recommended over c2 (weaker sustainability argument) and c3 (better for Instagram, but TikTok is the primary distribution target per the brand kit).

tools.why_this_provider: Real product photography already exists — no need to generate synthetic product images
Only TTS provider currently configured; ElevenLabs would sound better but requires a key
Only music-search provider configured; no local music_library/ tracks exist yet

stages.approach: No new image/video generation needed — the concept is built entirely from real product cutouts plus HyperFrames kinetic typography and brand color/type treatment.
stages.fallback_if_unavailable: If Pixabay search yields nothing on-brief, proceed without music and flag it rather than defaulting to AI music generation (unconfigured).

tools.role: Primary renderer — HTML/CSS/GSAP kinetic typography over product stills
tools.why_this_provider: Remotion is not installed in this environment (composition_runtimes.remotion=false); HyperFrames is purpose-built for 'kinetic typography, product promos, launch reels' per its own capability description — a better mechanical fit for this concept than Remotion would have been anyway, not just a fallback

stages.approach: Atelier composition mode: hand-authored kinetic type + product-reveal motion in this brand's exact palette (gold #D4AF37, cream #F5F1E8, navy #1a2845) and type system (Poppins/Inter/Cormorant Garamond), not the stock scene-type catalog.
stages.fallback_if_unavailable: ffmpeg Ken Burns fallback only with explicit user approval — this concept's whole premise (kinetic type as the visual lead) depends on real motion typography, so a still-image fallback would break the delivery promise.

quality_tradeoffs.tradeoff: Google TTS (free) vs ElevenLabs ($) for the optional CTA voiceover line
quality_tradeoffs.recommendation: Skip voiceover entirely for v1 — the concept is text/kinetic-type-led and TikTok performs well sound-off; add ElevenLabs later only if data shows voiceover lifts performance
quality_tradeoffs.quality_impact: No meaningful loss — avoids an unnecessary API key setup for one CTA line

alternative_paths.description: Current path: real product cutouts + HyperFrames kinetic type + Pixabay music, no paid providers
alternative_paths.what_changes: n/a — this is the recommended path

alternative_paths.description: Add ElevenLabs voiceover + FAL_KEY for AI-generated lifestyle b-roll inserts
alternative_paths.what_changes: Adds a spoken CTA and optional golden-hour b-roll cutaways; requires two new API keys

production_plan.art_direction: Angels in Daylight brand kit: gold #D4AF37 / cream #F5F1E8 / navy #1a2845, Poppins headlines + Inter body + Cormorant Garamond accent. Corrected from atelier: edit_decisions.schema.json bespoke.entry is defined as a Remotion .tsx entry — atelier mode requires Remotion, which is not installed. hyperframes + templated (via hyperframes_compose scaffold_workspace) is the only valid combination on this machine.

music_source.mood_direction: Confident, minimal, understated — not overly upbeat/hype; matches 'conscious luxury' tone

voice_selection.rationale: Concept is kinetic-type-led; voiceover deferred to a v2 test

line_items.notes: Local rendering via ffmpeg/HyperFrames, no API cost

approval.user_notes: User approved c1 explicitly via direct confirmation, requested render now (no manifest pre-review).
